title: D’Angelo Ponds, Kenyon Sadiq have each other to lean on as they hope to make Jets impact after injuries

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: D’Angelo Ponds, Kenyon Sadiq have each other to lean on as they hope to make Jets impact after injuries
sources.description: The Jets used two of their top four draft picks on D’Angelo Ponds and Kenyon Sadiq, hoping the two would make an immediate impact.
